recon.notes: Platform: static WordPress (Astra + UAGB blocks); everything is in the HTML, nothing loads by script. /events/ has two sections. (1) A weekday grid headed by the image this_weeks_events.png — MONDAY Stars of the Century, WEDNESDAY Pup Night & Warpzone, THURSDAY Thursday Country, FRIDAY Throwback Friday, SATURDAY Randy: Ball & Chain w/ Tony Moran — each block a weekday + hours and a name, never a date and never the words "every"/"weekly". (2) Dated specials under "September 2026" and "October 2026" headings ("FRIDAY, SEPT. 25 10pm-3am …"). Reading of the grid used here: Monday/Wednesday/Thursday are standing weekly nights (evergreen flyers from 2024–2025, the home-page banner literally named PupNight_EveryWed, "Thursday" in the night's name, and Pride-week editions of the Wednesday and Thursday nights listed in October at the same hours), so they are series with FREQ=WEEKLY and their Oct 7 / Oct 8 Pride editions folded in as listed occurrences with overrides. Friday and Saturday are this week's bookings, not series: their flyers are dated (AngelX_Sep18, uploaded this month), they have TICKETS buttons like the dated specials, and the home-page slider presents them as Facebook-event banners linking to /tickets, while the two standing nights' banners link to /events. They are documented as singles for Fri Sep 18 (already over at recon) and Sat Sep 19 with confidence ambiguous and expect.extracted "unknown" — see openQuestions. Every TICKETS button is the generic /tickets page, so ticketUrl is that page, not a per-event link. One dated special (Atlanta Pride Official Kickoff, Oct 9 7pm) is off-site at Georgia Aquarium. The street address in defaults is the parser config's (2069 Cheshire Bridge Rd NE); the cached pages publish none, and /contact/ was not read.

coverage.basis: All counts come from the single configured door, https://hereticatlanta.com/events/, a static page with no feed and no paging: 16 flyer+caption blocks. Weekday grid (5 blocks): 3 standing weekly nights → 3 series (Stars of the Century MO, Pup Night & Warpzone WE, Thursday Country TH), and 2 this-week bookings → 2 singles (Throwback Friday Sep 18, Randy: Ball & Chain Sep 19). Dated sections (2 September + 9 October blocks = 11): the Oct 7 Pup Pride and Oct 8 Country Pride blocks are the Pride editions of the Wednesday and Thursday series and are folded in as listed occurrences with overrides, leaving 9 singles (Club Trade Sep 25, Ben Bakson Sep 26, Pride Kickoff at Georgia Aquarium Oct 9, Kickoff After Party Oct 9, Bootea Oct 10, DJ Alex Ramos Oct 10, Randy Outdoor Tea Dance Oct 11, Dan Slater Oct 11, Vampire Ball Oct 23). publishedEventCount = 3 + 2 + 9 = 14. Series occurrences are RRULE arithmetic for 2026-09-19..2026-12-18 (origin rule) except the two dated Pride editions (origin listed). The home page (not in parser urls) adds no event the /events/ page lacks. Confidence is medium rather than high because the grid states no repeat in words and the Friday/Saturday reading (booking vs weekly) cannot be settled from one snapshot. No past listings: the page shows this week and the two months ahead only.
knownGaps: The FRIDAY and SATURDAY blocks of the weekday grid carry no date; they are documented as this week's bookings (Sep 18 / Sep 19) on flyer-filename and banner-link evidence, not on page text. A second snapshot in a later week settles it (same names → weekly series; new names → bookings).
The /tickets/ page was not read, so the ticketing platform and per-event ticket links (if any) are unknown; every ticketUrl here is the generic /tickets/ page the buttons point at.
The site publishes no street address on the cached pages; defaults.address is the parser config's value and /contact/ was not read.
Series occurrences after the October Pride week are rule-derived; the site itself lists only the current week plus dated specials through Oct 23.

traps.label: Home-page swiper slider of six Facebook-event banner images (no caption text)
traps.why: The home page is a flyer carousel: six wp-block-image slides (Randy: Ball & Chain, Angel X Sep 18, Ben Bakson Sep 26, Club Trade 9/25, Thursday Country, Pup Night Every Wed) with empty alt text, linking to /tickets or /events. Every one duplicates an /events/ entry, and the page carries no dates or times, so anything read from here is either a duplicate or an OCR guess. The home page is not in the parser's urls.
traps.note: Recorded because the slide filenames (…_FBevent.jpg, PupNight_EveryWed) are the best corroboration on the site for which weekday-grid entries are standing nights.

traps.label: TICKETS button under ten /events/ blocks, all href="/tickets"
traps.why: The button looks like a per-event ticket link but every one of the ten points at the same site-wide tickets page (https://hereticatlanta.com/tickets/). It is not an event and it does not identify which event it belongs to; a scraper that follows it finds a page, not a ticket for that night.

evidence.quote: TICKETS

traps.note: The events above carry that page as ticketUrl because it is what the site publishes; the trap is about not treating the button as a distinct event or as proof of a per-event link.

openQuestions.q: Are the FRIDAY ("Throwback Friday", flyer AngelX_Sep18) and SATURDAY ("Randy: Ball & Chain w/ Tony Moran") blocks of the "this week's events" grid standing weekly nights or this week's bookings? This file documents them as singles (Sep 18 / Sep 19). Re-read /events/ in a later week: if the same two names are still there, convert them to FREQ=WEEKLY series.

Should the Oct 7 "Pride 2026: Pup Pride & Warpzone" and Oct 8 "Pride 2026: Country Pride" blocks count as separate published events (singles) rather than overridden occurrences of the Wednesday/Thursday series? This file folds them in; counting them separately would make publishedEventCount 16.
